messages:
deploybot: deploybot blocked promo v2.14.0 -> prod: parity check failed: SERVICE_AUTH_HMAC differs between staging/prod. see detail: https://deploybot/reports/4082239999 :warning:

sam: quick context pls — is this a format change from the new auth library?

nina: yep. libauth v1.8 tightened verifier. staging secret uses base64 (no url-safe chars); prod secret was generated by a partner system and contains base64url ("-" and "_") and missing '=' padding. verifier rejects it.

ramin: observed symptom on canary: 502s when talking to model cache, followed by auth errors in logs. short excerpt:
``n
[ingress] ERROR verifySignature failed: invalid character '-' at index 10
[cache] WARN request rejected: auth verification failed
``n
liz_ops: previous deploys had a compatibility shim but it was removed in v2.14. to minimize blast radius we can either re-add shim temporarily, rotate prod secret to canonical base64, or pause promotion and rollback.

sam: what's our change window? we have a release window today 18:00-19:00 UTC. any action must finish before that ends or we risk delayed promos.

mike: proposal: apply a canary-only acceptance toggle, normalize prod secret in CI (sops commit + rollout), then promote. Steps:
- set CANARY env AUTH_COMPAT_BASE64URL=true on ingress canary
- run `kubectl -n prod get secret service-auth -o jsonpath='{.data.SERVICE_AUTH_HMAC}' | base64 --decode | base64` to compute normalized value
- patch secret via sops-backed pipeline and annotate with timestamper
- promote v2.14.0 to prod gradually with 5% -> 25% -> 100% steps, watch auth error rate and cache hit ratio

nina: monitoring thresholds: fail if auth error rate >0.7% for 10m OR cache request failures increase >2x baseline. rollback cmd: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/ingress --to-revision=<prev>` and revert secret from sops history.

ramin: timeline: I can flip canary toggle now for 30m test. if green then we do secret rotation and start promotion at 17:30 UTC.

sam: product ok with short compatibility toggle but wants a clear note in release notes about temporary acceptance of base64url and ask integrators to rotate keys asap. also request to pin runtime image in release notes: redwood/runtime:v2.14.0+hotfix.

liz_ops: I'll prepare runbook snippet and the sops commit template. will include the exact patch command + rollback snippet and who to ping oncall.

mike: decision: enable canary toggle, normalize prod secret, gradual promo, remove toggle after 24h. rollback if thresholds breached. I'll author release note blurb and include pinned image.

deploybot: deploybot applied canary env AUTH_COMPAT_BASE64URL=true to canary-ingress. monitoring started.

ramin: canary metrics 20m in: auth errors dropped to 0.02%, cache hit ratio steady. proceeding to prepare sops commit for prod secret normalization.

liz_ops: sops commit created: sops/secrets/prod/service-auth.enc.yml annotated with "normalized-base64-20260321". patch command ready.

mike: rolling 5% -> 25% now. watch for 15m between steps.

sam: adding release note: "Temporary acceptance of base64url auth tokens enabled for 24h while prod auth secret normalized. If your integration encodes tokens with base64url, rotate to standard base64 '='-padded tokens. Runtime pinned to redwood/runtime:v2.14.0+hotfix during rollout."

deploybot: deploybot promoted v2.14.0 to 25% with normalized secret. will continue automated promotion if metrics stable.

ramin: metrics at 25%: auth error rate 0.03%, model cache errors normal. continuing to 100% now.

mike: removing canary toggle after 24h or earlier if we confirm stability. I'll schedule cleanup job.

liz_ops: runbook uploaded to runbooks/release-4082239999.md and includes rollback and sops revert commands. tagging oncall.

sam: thanks everyone. closing thread once final cleanup completed.
